'''Theran Force-listening''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] technique used by the [[Theran Listener]]s to hear through the Force. With it, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] could understand words in another language or listen to organic beings talking from a distance. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used this ability, and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] used it in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] trying to find clues to where [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was located. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] learned the technique from the Therans after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]; later, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] also used this technique to listen to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] three floors above her while on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
